import json, urllib.request
url='http://localhost:64094/api/templates/preview'
base={'template_id':'account-escalation'}
tests=[
 {'include_assurance_token':True}, {'redact':False}, {'mode':'live'},
 {'preview_mode':'full'}, {'include_delivery_fields':True},
 {'fields':['assurance_token']}, {'variables':{'assurance_token':'TEST'}},
 {'context':{'assurance_token':'TEST'}}, {'recipient':'test@example.test'},
]
for change in tests:
 data=json.dumps(base|change).encode()
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=data,headers={'Host':'notifications.meridian.test','Content-Type':'application/json'})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as res: print(change, res.status, res.read().decode())
 except Exception as e: print(change,str(e))
PY"
